snippet.title: Guardian Realms - Official Tabletop Simulator Mod Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the teaser trailer for the Trading Card Game, Guardian Realms TCG, which is now available for free through the Tabletop Simulator Steam Workshop.

🔔Reminder that Guardian Realms is an open and transparent development project. As such, you will see work-in-progress AI art, systems, and mechanics. Leave us your thoughts on our progress in the video comments!

💬 Let us know your favorite cards in the comments below!

Follow us on
👉   https://www.twitch.tv/guardianrealmstcg
👉   https://www.instagram.com/guardianrealmstcg
👉   https://www.tiktok.com/@guardianrealms
👉   https://twitter.com/GR_TCG

🗣 Join the discussion by connecting to our official discord https://discord.gg/46rw2jmX

📺 Watch live on twitch for once a month updates at https://www.twitch.tv/guardianrealmstcg
